title: rk-lean: the directed construction for k-th-power-difference-free sets at every k, with the exponents 0.912145 (k = 4) and 0.950826 (k = 6)
summary: A Lean 4 proof of Krachun's directed (acyclic-block) lower-bound construction for sets of integers with no k-th-power difference, stated and proved for every exponent k >= 2. Let D_k(N) be the largest size of a subset of {1,...,N} no two of whose elements differ by a nonzero perfect k-th power.
